videos.title: The $1B Company Fixing AI’s Software Bottleneck
videos.description:
Blacksmith (YC W24) is building a faster cloud for continuous integration (CI), helping developers test and ship code as AI coding tools generate more of it.

As software production accelerates, testing and validation are becoming the new bottleneck. That shift has helped Blacksmith grow 20x over the last year, and the company recently raised a $66 million Series C at a $1 billion valuation.

The founders started as outsiders to DevOps and built their first infrastructure using the same high-performance CPUs found in gaming PCs, renting servers originally designed for Minecraft and Call of Duty. Today, they run a much larger fleet with a team of just 30 people, helping companies cut CI waits from minutes to seconds. 

In this first episode of Built to a Billion, they share how they found the idea, won their first 200 customers, and why faster testing will become even more important as agents write more of the world’s code.

https://blacksmith.sh

videos.title: LLM Cache கத்துக்கலாம்🔥 | Stop Wasting LLM Tokens (தமிழில்)
videos.description:
🚀 Want to make your LLM applications faster, cheaper, and more efficient?

LLM Caching is one of the most important optimization techniques every AI Engineer and GenAI Developer should understand.

In this video, we'll explore 4 powerful types of LLM Caching with simple explanations and practical examples.

🔥 Topics Covered:

KV Cache (Key-Value Cache) – How LLMs avoid recomputing previous tokens during text generation.

Prefix Cache – How LLMs reuse computation for shared prompt prefixes.

Prompt Cache – How frequently used prompts and prompt components can be cached to reduce latency and costs.

Semantic Cache – How to reuse responses for semantically similar user queries without calling the LLM again.

🎯 By the end of this video, you'll understand how these caching techniques work and when to use each one in real-world LLM applications.

Whether you're learning Generative AI, building AI Agents, or developing production-ready LLM applications, this is a must-know concept!
